name: Talent
overview: Scripture reveals that talents, both as a measure of weight and as God-given abilities, hold significant value and purpose. The passages in Exodus and 1 Kings highlight the substantial worth of talents in gold and silver, emphasizing their importance in worship and royal wealth. Additionally, talents are associated with God’s gifting of wisdom, understanding, and craftsmanship to His people, as seen in Exodus 31 and 35, underscoring that these abilities are divinely bestowed for service and obedience.
